events.message: Launch started / finite thrust ascent. Flight timing is automatic; a parking orbit holds the vehicle until its computed transfer window.
ASCENT -> TRANSFER / Departure impulse executed. Universal-variable propagation preserves the complete 3-D orbit.
TRANSFER -> CAPTURE ORBIT / Orbital capture impulse 3627 m/s. Planet-relative Kepler coast to 6 km periapsis; terminal fuel reserved.
CAPTURE ORBIT -> BRAKING + DESCENT / Deorbit impulse 3912 m/s. Chemical engine now uses finite thrust, mass flow, attitude inertia, drag and damped landing legs.
BRAKING + DESCENT -> LANDED / Factory kit unloaded / shared drone fleet deployment pending
